title: Zero Trust MVP · Screen & flow atlas
scope: Current mvp checkpoint only. All included MVP capabilities are always on. The archived /?view=full workspace is outside this atlas.
boundaries: Role switching demonstrates five interfaces; it is not authentication or backend authorization.
All decisions, dataset metadata, column names and attached text evidence are local browser state. Import preview rows are discarded when the import dialog closes.

Execution, repository evidence, output samples, approval shortcuts and support requests are demonstrations. No repository analysis, research code execution, PHI scanning, security enforcement or external support delivery occurs.
Screen IDs describe UI states, including dialogs and inline panels. They are documentation anchors, not routes in the live single-page app.
Wireframe clicks navigate this document; they never change the live prototype. Return means the actual originating page, not a fixed destination.

personas.name: Researcher
personas.objective: Register data and describe, revise, publish and run a reviewed research method.
personas.pain: Unclear submission requirements, handoffs and usable output status.
personas.gain: A visible path from a named draft to a traceable, accepted output.

personas.name: Ethical reviewer
personas.objective: Assess intended use, consent boundaries, harms and limitations.
personas.pain: Research context and evidence are scattered.
personas.gain: Purpose and evidence appear beside an explicit stage decision.

personas.name: Technical reviewer
personas.objective: Assess runtime and input/output evidence; resolve local run-support requests.
personas.pain: Incomplete contracts and failures with little context.
personas.gain: A dedicated checklist, run log and recorded support resolution.

personas.name: Privacy reviewer
personas.objective: Assess handling and disclosure risks, then separately accept or reject generated output.
personas.pain: Pipeline approval can be confused with output validation.
personas.gain: A distinct output decision gates sample download.

personas.name: Security reviewer
personas.objective: Assess dependency, secrets, network and permission evidence.
personas.pain: Security can become an implicit or skipped handoff.
personas.gain: A mandatory final review before a separate author publication.

globalRules: Initial entry is Pipelines as Researcher; valid saved workspace data is restored. Navigation and demo role are not persisted.

The six navigation destinations are Overview, Datasets, Pipelines, Runs & results, Approvals and Activity log. Mobile uses a closeable navigation drawer. Navigating closes the drawer and resets selected detail context.

Header role selector offers Researcher, Ethical reviewer, Technical reviewer, Privacy reviewer and Security reviewer. Changing role keeps the current page; controls and task eligibility update. It does not advance an approval.
Every submitted pipeline, revision and new version requires Ethical → Technical → Privacy → Security, followed by Researcher publication. A pipeline is runnable only when Approved.

At widths up to 900px all labelled CTA controls use full container width and their own row; the primary action comes first in visual and keyboard order. Utility icons remain compact touch targets. Task dialogs become fullscreen on phones/short mobile viewports.
Search, filters, disclosures, evidence preview, field errors and neutral decision selection are in-place states unless a transition below says otherwise. No extra screen is implied.

Browser refresh restores valid stored records and decisions, then returns to initial Pipelines / Researcher; running demos resume their timer. With unavailable storage the current session works and a warning says changes may not survive refresh.

Close, Cancel, Escape or backdrop dismiss a dismissible dialog to its underlying page. Unsaved wizard edits are discarded unless Save draft was used. Import preview rows are discarded. Reset requires its own confirmation.
Edited pipeline forms require an explicit save, keep-editing or discard choice when closing. Browser navigation warns about unsaved forms.
Workspace saves are serialized across tabs. Unreadable data is preserved for download and explicit recovery; unsupported atomic storage uses session-only changes.

The visual palette is always on: mint #2BE1B0 primary fills with dark labels, dark secondary and tertiary labels, deeper green selection and focus, slate #8C91A4 accents, amber #FEAB3D warnings and coral #F8506D destructive accents. No theme or feature toggle is required.

Review progress uses green completed markers, amber current-step markers, dashed slate pending markers and coral markers for stages needing changes. A legend, marker sizes, checkmarks and text labels make the states clear beyond color.

Progress states are always on: completed steps use green and checkmarks; active form, review and execution steps use amber; pending steps use slate and dashed markers; failed or changes-required states use coral. Run progress retains its percentage and explicit status. There is no feature or settings toggle.

screens.goal: Read the recorded response and continue recovery independently.
layout: Parent run status and actions remain visible

stories.text: As a researcher, I want a durable support receipt so that I can understand the response before rerunning.
acceptance: Resolved note is read-only.
Resolving support does not itself make a run Completed or validate output.

actions.label: Retry / Restart parent run
actions.outcome: Same parent run restarts; receipt remains.

screens.title: Runs & results · Results
screens.goal: Find output validation status and inspect provenance.
layout: No results empty state · demo notice

stories.text: As a participant, I want a result list that separates generated from accepted output so that I know what is usable.
acceptance: Search matches output name and dataset.
Pending, Validated and Not acceptable remain distinct.
Opening an output resolves to the role/status-specific artifact view.

screens.title: Artifact review · Awaiting Privacy reviewer
screens.goal: Inspect synthetic output and hand off to the validator.
layout: Source dataset · run / version · declared output
Declared record count vs synthetic preview row count

stories.text: As a researcher, I want to see output before validation while understanding why download is blocked.
acceptance: Sample download is disabled while Pending review.
Continue as Privacy reviewer changes role within the same open artifact.
Preview is synthetic and contract-specific, not the imported source rows.

actions.label: Continue as Privacy reviewer
actions.outcome: Role switch only; no acceptance implied.

actions.label: Simulation controls
actions.outcome: Close artifact and preselect it in simulator; closing simulator does not reopen it.

screens.title: Artifact review · Privacy decision
screens.goal: Make an explicit output acceptance or rejection decision.
layout: Pending review · provenance and synthetic preview

stories.text: As a privacy reviewer, I want an unselected decision and output preview so that acceptance is deliberate and separate from pipeline approval.
acceptance: Decision CTA stays disabled until a radio option is chosen.
Acceptable allows optional comments; Not acceptable requires a reason.
Decision updates status and records reviewer, time, comment and activity.

actions.label: Accept output
actions.outcome: Status Validated; sample download enabled.

actions.label: Reject output
actions.outcome: Status Not acceptable; download blocked.

actions.label: Choose outcome / add comment
actions.outcome: Choosing rejection without comment shows an error on submit.

actions.label: Simulation controls
actions.outcome: Artifact closes; not automatically reopened after simulation.

screens.title: Artifact review · Accepted / download
screens.goal: Read validation receipt and download the synthetic sample.

stories.text: As a researcher, I want the decision receipt beside a clearly labelled sample download so that I can use the accepted demonstration result.
acceptance: Download is enabled only for Validated.
CSV contains the small synthetic preview fixture, not the declared dataset-sized output.
Download does not close the dialog.

actions.label: Download sample CSV
actions.outcome: Download synthetic fixture CSV, show toast.

screens.title: Artifact review · Rejected
screens.goal: Read the rejection and plan a fresh output.

stories.text: As a researcher, I want a visible output rejection reason so that I can investigate and create a new output for review.
acceptance: Download remains disabled.
There is no direct re-open or overturn decision action.
Recovery requires closing, starting a new run and reviewing its new artifact.

actions.label: Simulation controls
actions.outcome: Cannot accept an already rejected artifact; only Pending review artifacts can be simulated.

screens.title: Activity log
screens.goal: Trace local workflow events and reopen their current entities.
layout: Filter by event type, specific entity and date disclosure
Timestamp · actor · event · entity · version / note

stories.text: As a participant, I want searchable, exportable event context so that I can inspect who did what and continue from a related record.
acceptance: Search, event type, specific entity and inclusive date range combine.
Export includes the filtered events, filter values and generation timestamp in JSON.
Entity links open current record state, not a frozen historical screen.
No matches offers Clear filters.

notes: Local history is not an immutable production audit trail.

actions.label: Export history
actions.outcome: Download filtered workspace activity JSON.

actions.label: Open pipeline event
actions.guard: Resolve by current status/role to S11/S13–S17/S19–S22.

actions.label: Open dataset event
actions.outcome: Navigate to Datasets and open dataset detail.

actions.label: Open run event
actions.guard: Resolve by current status to S25–S28.
actions.outcome: Navigate to Runs and open detail.

actions.label: Open artifact event
actions.outcome: Artifact opens over Activity log.

screens.title: Simulation controls
screens.goal: Unblock outside-person and timer events in a solo walkthrough.
layout: Execution events disclosure · Complete waiting runs
Output validation disclosure · Demo output · Simulate output acceptance

stories.text: As a demo participant, I want quiet simulation shortcuts so that waiting for people or systems does not prevent completion.
acceptance: Review shortcuts create attributed, explicitly simulated review events.
Remaining reviews stop at Ready to publish; publication remains a distinct action.
Complete waiting runs only finishes currently Running runs.
Output acceptance only applies to Pending review and records a simulated Privacy decision.
Return to prototype closes simulator; artifact/run dialogs closed on entry do not reopen.

notes: Drafts require submission before review shortcuts; rejected/feedback submissions require revision.
These shortcuts are always available in the local prototype, not feature toggles or production bypasses.

actions.label: Simulate current stage approval
actions.outcome: Advance one stage; update controls and history.

actions.label: Simulate remaining reviews
actions.outcome: Complete remaining stages, stop at Ready to publish.

actions.label: Simulate author publication
actions.outcome: Separate publish event; status Approved.

actions.label: Complete waiting runs
actions.outcome: Dispatch enough timer ticks to create Pending review outputs.

actions.label: Simulate output acceptance
actions.outcome: Status Validated; does not re-open artifact.

screens.title: Explore the MVP · Guide
screens.goal: Understand the demo sequence or jump to a starting task.

stories.text: As a first-time participant, I want a concise walkthrough so that I can demonstrate the complete journey.
acceptance: Create and Import shortcuts explicitly set Researcher role.
Guide closes before a chosen task opens.

actions.label: Create a pipeline
actions.outcome: Set Researcher; start new wizard.

actions.label: Import data
actions.outcome: Set Researcher; open import.

screens.title: Reset demo workspace
screens.goal: Restore seeded records deliberately.
layout: Local changes / decisions replaced by seed

stories.text: As a demo participant, I want a confirmed reset so that I can repeat the walkthrough from its original records.
acceptance: Reset clears locally created records and decisions, restores seed and returns to Pipelines as Researcher.
Cancel leaves the workspace unchanged.
When recovering unreadable data, save a separate recovery copy before replacing it; a failed backup or save keeps the recovery screen available.

actions.label: Reset demo
actions.outcome: Restore seeded workspace; close all selected context; role Researcher.

screens.title: Evidence attachment · Text preview
screens.goal: Read locally attached evidence without leaving the selected pipeline.

stories.text: As a reviewer, I want to open the author’s attached text evidence so that I can assess the submission in context.
acceptance: Clicking an attached filename opens a nested text preview.
Missing content displays “No text preview available.”
Close preview returns to the same pipeline detail and keeps the current stage and role.
Text is displayed as text; files are not executed or uploaded.

notes: Attachment previews are reachable from submission evidence or attached evidence in pipeline details. The wizard attachment picker itself lists/removes files; it has no preview dialog.

actions.label: Close preview
actions.outcome: Return to the originating pipeline detail/review state.

screens.title: Save your changes?
screens.goal: Protect unsaved pipeline fields and evidence when closing the wizard.

stories.text: As an author, I want to choose whether to save or discard my edits so that closing a form does not silently lose work.
acceptance: Escape, backdrop, Close and Cancel request confirmation when the form is edited.
Keep editing and dismissing the confirmation retain fields and evidence in the same wizard step.
Save draft validates the name and retains incomplete working fields; stale writes keep the form open.
Discard changes closes the form without changing the saved submission.

notes: The same confirmation protects all three wizard steps. Keep editing returns to the step that opened it.
The catalog is the representative discard destination; editing or revising from pipeline details returns to that original page.

actions.label: Save draft / Save revision draft
actions.guard: Named draft and evidence reading complete
actions.outcome: Save working fields; feedback/rejected revisions retain S19/S20 instead of changing their reviewed status.

actions.label: Keep editing
actions.outcome: Return to the same wizard step with every field and attachment retained.

actions.label: Discard changes
actions.outcome: Close the wizard and return to the page that opened it; catalog shown as representative.

screens.title: Your saved workspace needs recovery
screens.goal: Preserve unreadable saved data or an unsaved local copy before choosing how to recover.
layout: Explanation of unreadable data or a concurrent-save conflict
Reset saved workspace OR Load saved workspace

stories.text: As a participant, I want a recoverable copy of my work so that a damaged record or conflicting save cannot silently erase it.
acceptance: Unreadable saved bytes remain unchanged until an explicit reset.
Download returns the exact protected copy.
A reset first stores a recovery backup, then starts a fresh demo; Cancel preserves the existing data.
After a failed local save and a conflicting remote save, the local copy remains downloadable and the remote copy is not overwritten.
Load saved workspace first backs up local changes and then resumes from the saved copy.

notes: This page replaces workspace editing until recovery completes.
A storage warning without a conflict does not require this page; session changes remain usable and can be saved later.
If backup or storage fails, keep the recovery download and resolve browser storage before retrying.

actions.label: Download recovery copy
actions.outcome: Download protected original bytes or the unsaved local workspace.

actions.label: Reset saved workspace
actions.outcome: Ask for explicit reset; preserve a recovery backup before replacement.

actions.label: Load saved workspace
actions.guard: Concurrent-save conflict and readable saved copy
actions.outcome: Back up local copy, load latest saved workspace and retain the current area.

journeys.title: Find your way
journeys.goal: Navigate the workspace and choose a starting task.
journeys.entry: Initial Pipelines; shell is shared by every page.
journeys.done: A destination is selected; role remains the same unless a guide shortcut sets Researcher.

journeys.title: Import & inspect a dataset
journeys.goal: Register a source before configuring a run.
journeys.entry: Researcher; Datasets or guide Import data.
journeys.done: Dataset metadata exists locally; source is preselected for a run.

journeys.title: Create, save & submit
journeys.goal: Work through the three-step wizard, including incomplete drafts.
journeys.entry: Researcher; new name or a saved draft.
journeys.done: Author sees submission receipt; Ethical review is pending.

journeys.title: Four reviews & author publication
journeys.goal: Complete each required organizational stage before publishing.
journeys.entry: Submitted pipeline; role selector or Continue as actions supply each handoff.
journeys.done: Pipeline Approved after a separate Researcher publish event. Edge labels that combine approval + role switch represent two actions; after approval the UI first shows S13 waiting for the next reviewer.

journeys.title: Feedback, rejection & revision
journeys.goal: Recover a paused review without losing its evidence or history.
journeys.entry: Any assigned stage can request changes/reject; Ethical is shown as the example.
journeys.done: Revised version starts all four reviews again. For a rejected record, Save revision draft returns to S20, not S19.

journeys.title: Submit a new version
journeys.goal: Keep a published source available while reviewing an update.
journeys.done: A separate basedOn record enters full review; the earlier approved version remains runnable.

journeys.title: Run & inspect output
journeys.goal: Configure a compatible run and inspect the synthetic result.
journeys.entry: Researcher; Approved method and registered format-compatible dataset.
journeys.done: Completed run has a distinct Pending review artifact; no download yet.

journeys.title: Failure, cancellation & support
journeys.goal: Recover a seeded failure or a cancelled run.
journeys.entry: Seeded Failed run or an active Running run.
journeys.done: Recovery creates a new pending output on completion; resolving support alone does not change run status.

journeys.title: Validate, reject or download output
journeys.goal: Make a deliberate Privacy decision before sample download.
journeys.entry: Completed artifact Pending review; neither radio option is selected initially.
journeys.done: Accepted output enables sample download; rejected output requires a fresh run for a new decision. The rejected-to-configure wire is a recovery sequence through the underlying Runs/Results page, not a CTA inside the rejected dialog.

journeys.title: Trace, export & reopen
journeys.goal: Inspect local history and open the related current record.
journeys.done: Filtered history downloads as JSON, or the current related entity opens. Link destinations vary with current record status; this is not a historical replay.

journeys.title: Solo demo shortcuts & reset
journeys.goal: Continue across external-person and timer dependencies.
journeys.entry: Any role; sidebar, Demo mode, workspace menu or run/artifact dialog shortcut.
journeys.done: Simulator actions happen inside S38; wires show outcomes after returning/reopening the applicable record. The underlying page is preserved. Reset is a separate confirmed action.

journeys.title: Attach & inspect review evidence
journeys.goal: Carry local text evidence from a submission into each reviewer’s assessment.
journeys.entry: Researcher in the submission wizard; optional supported text files.
journeys.done: A reviewer reads the exact locally attached text and returns to the same assessment. Any pipeline detail may open this preview; Ethical is shown as an example.

journeys.title: Protect edits and recover saved work
journeys.goal: Keep form edits and saved work recoverable when closing, saving in multiple tabs or encountering damaged storage.
journeys.entry: Close an edited wizard, or encounter protected workspace recovery.
journeys.done: A draft is saved, edits are explicitly discarded, or a protected copy is downloaded/backed up before recovery.
edges: Back up local copy and load saved workspace
